svg.desc: Activation patching. Left: a pre-norm transformer block (norm, attention heads, W_o, residual add, norm, MLP, residual add) with the five sites head_z, attn_out, resid_mid, mlp_out and resid_post. Right: grids of blocks by tokens for the corrupted run 'The Colosseum is located in the city of' (answer Rome) and the clean run 'The Eiffel Tower is located in the city of' (answer Paris); one cell, the last subject token at a middle block, is copied from the corrupted run into the clean run, where it can change the cells above it and to its right; the logit difference LD between Paris and Rome is read at the final position after the last block.
